schedule.title: Time + action
schedule.bodyMarkdown:
You can now understand a simple schedule:

- **Lendi maten, mwen etidye kreyòl.**
- **Setè edmi, mwen travay.**
- **Aswè, mwen li.**

The goal is not advanced tense. It is to connect familiar actions with useful time expressions.

ask-schedule.title: Akilè…?
ask-schedule.bodyMarkdown:
Ask about the time of an activity:

**Akilè ou travay?** — What time do you work?

A simple answer can be:

**Setè edmi.**

everyday-life.title: Numbers + time + routines
everyday-life.bodyMarkdown:
This module gives you the tools to understand small pieces of everyday life:

- quantities: **de liv**
- clock time: **senkè**
- day parts: **maten**, **aswè**
- frequency: **chak jou**
- current time: **kounyeya**

These pieces will support longer conversations in later courses.
